method.value: The merchant says Shopify Autopilot was in early access and connected to automate ads on Meta, Shop, and more. They turned it on, accepted several setting changes it suggested, then manually raised the daily budget in Meta when it barely spent; another commenter said Autopilot created a Meta ad and adjusted budgets, but did not actually serve it.

outcome.value: In the thread, it largely failed to get going: after four days the original poster said it had spent only €0.26 total, then only a few more cents later, and another user reported a full week with no spend. When the poster forced spend by changing Meta budget directly, they said targeting was way off and the traffic was low quality.

notes.value: The main catch was underdelivery: even after several days and accepted suggestions, it spent only cents, so the poster did not think it was worth it yet.

source_text.body:
Automate store ad campaigns with Shopify Autopilot
A merchant in early access uses Shopify's Autopilot to automate ad systems on Meta, Shop and more, running store marketing more hands-off.
·
Sep 1, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The merchant says Shopify Autopilot was in early access and connected to automate ads on Meta, Shop, and more. They turned it on, accepted several setting changes it suggested, then manually raised the daily budget in Meta when it barely spent; another commenter said Autopilot created a Meta ad and adjusted budgets, but did not actually serve it.
How it went
In the thread, it largely failed to get going: after four days the original poster said it had spent only €0.26 total, then only a few more cents later, and another user reported a full week with no spend. When the poster forced spend by changing Meta budget directly, they said targeting was way off and the traffic was low quality.
Worth knowing
The main catch was underdelivery: even after several days and accepted suggestions, it spent only cents, so the poster did not think it was worth it yet.
Try it yourself
with
Operator
Copy prompt
Open my [Shopify/ad platform] admin at [URL] and review the current ad campaigns for my store on [Meta/Google/other channels]. Summarize each campaign's spend, return, and settings, and recommend what to change to run them more hands-off, such as budgets, audiences, and automation features. Don't change settings, turn on automation, or spend money. Show me exactly what you plan to do and wait for my approval before each step.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/shopify/comments/1vkb4ix/anyone_using_autopilot_yet
